concepts.label: Create a Search Index Alias with the Web Console (task/how-to page)

notable_absence.finding: No role/privilege is stated in the Prerequisites for creating a Search index alias, unlike the sibling page create-quick-index.md which explicitly requires the 'Search Admin' role. Since an alias is itself a kind of index object, the same or a related privilege likely applies but is undocumented here - an inconsistency within the same doc set, not just an isolated gap.

competency_questions_addressed: How do I create a Search index alias spanning multiple buckets/scopes/indexes?
